def _matches_edit(before, after, line, operation, target):
    if operation == 'quantity':
        delta = 1 if target == before['plus'] else -1
        return after['count'] == before['count'] + delta and after['selected'] == before['selected']
    if operation in ('numeric_increase', 'numeric_decrease'):
        expected = {c['name']:c['value'] for c in before['numeric']}
        expected[target['name']] += target['step'] if operation == 'numeric_increase' else -target['step']
        return (after['count'] == before['count'] and _signature(after).get('numeric') == expected
                and {option_value(e) for e in after['choices'] if e['selected']} ==
                    {option_value(e) for e in before['choices'] if e['selected']})
    name = option_value(target)
    return after['count'] == before['count'] and (name in after['selected']) == (name in line['options'])


def _settled_edit(desktop, state, scope, before, line, operation, target):
    # Chromium may publish the output numeral, price label and button geometry
    # in separate accessibility updates. These retries never send input.
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 1.5
    prior = None
    while True:
        desktop.check_stop()
        fresh = desktop.read_dialog_batch(state, scope)
        title = fresh.get('draft_item') or (fresh.get('order_detail') or {}).get('item')
        if title and title != line['item']:
            raise DialogQuantityUnconfirmed('옵션을 조정한 뒤 다른 상품의 옵션 창이 열렸습니다.')
        after = _controls(fresh)
        step = _next(after, line) if after and _matches_edit(before, after, line, operation, target) else None
        if step:
            # Include the next physical control, so a replaced or moved Add is
            # rebound from its latest snapshot, never from the original click.
            signature = (_signature(after), step[0], step[1]['id'], step[1]['rect'])
            if signature == prior:
                return fresh
            prior = signature
        else:
            prior = None
        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            elements = fresh.get('elements', ())
            choices = [e for e in elements if e['role'] in ('RadioButton', 'CheckBox')]
            adds = [(e, price) for e in elements if (price := draft_add_amount(fresh, e)) is not None]
            digits = [n for n in fresh.get('draft_texts', ()) if re.fullmatch(r'[1-9]\d?', n)]
            add_details = ', '.join(f"{price}원, 위치 {e.get('rect')}, "
                                    f"클릭 가능 {center(e, fresh) is not None}" for e, price in adds)
            detail = (f"상품명 확인 {bool(title)}, 수량 {after['count'] if after else '?'}, "
                      f"창 안의 숫자 {digits}, 수량 버튼 {len(fresh.get('draft_quantity_ids', ()))}개, "
                      f"선택 표시 {sum(e.get('selected') is True for e in choices)}/{len(choices)}개, "
                      f"금액이 표시된 담기 버튼 {len(adds)}개 ({add_details})")
            raise DialogQuantityUnconfirmed('상품 옵션·수량 변경 결과를 확인하지 못했습니다. '+detail)
        time.sleep(.045)


        fresh = _settled_edit(desktop,state,scope,ui,line,operation,target)
